description.text: The second expansion of the DP series, released on 2 March 2007. Its theme is the three lakes of Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, Lake Acuity, Lake Valor and Lake Verity, and the legendary Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf that live in them. The three are bound by a mysterious power, and some of their attacks and Poké-Bodies only work when all three are in play on the same side. Lucario, Electivire and Magmortar appear as LV.X. In English the set became Mysterious Treasures in August 2007.
